abort.not_supported: This device doesn't look like a supported Philips remote.

init.title: Philips remote options
init.description: Tick the buttons that should detect a double press. Pressing one of them twice within the delay fires a single event ending in _double (for example on_double). A ticked button is held for the delay to see whether a second press follows, so its single presses are delayed by that long. Unticked buttons are reported instantly.

data_description.double_press_delay: How long to wait for a second press (0.1 to 2 seconds).
